title: Assembly of the stalk tensor pullback chain square
statement: Fix a cartesian square of schemes $X'\xrightarrow{g'}X$, $S'\xrightarrow g S$, $f:X\to S$, $f':X'\to S'$ and a point $z\in X'$. Use its actual stalk rings $R,A,B,C$ and the scalar-extension functor $F$ and stalk functors of [def-pc-single-complex-base-change-stalk-condition]. Let $P,Q$ be arbitrary complexes on $X$, $N$ an arbitrary complex on $X'$, and $a:H Q\to N$ a chain map, where $H$ is termwise module pullback. Suppose $\chi:H\operatorname{Tot}(P\otimes Q)\cong\operatorname{Tot}(HP\otimes HQ)$ restricts on every total-degree summand to the specified module pullback tensor isomorphism [lem-weil-pbc-module-pullback-tensor]. Write $U=P_{g'z}$, $V=Q_{g'z}$, and $t=\operatorname{tensorStalkIso}(Q);S(a)$, with $S$ the stalk complex functor on $X'$ at $z$. There exist chain isomorphisms $\sigma:U\otimes V\cong(\operatorname{Tot}(P\otimes Q))_{g'z}$ and $\rho:F(U)\otimes S(N)\cong S(\operatorname{Tot}(HP\otimes N))$ such that $F(\sigma);\operatorname{tensorStalkIso}(\operatorname{Tot}(P\otimes Q));S(\chi;(1\otimes a))=\mu_F^{-1};(1\otimes t);\rho$. No K-flatness, derived identification, boundedness, or horizontal invertibility is assumed.

proof.text: Use the proved pinned stalk tensor comparison at the source and target points. Define σ as the inverse source comparison; define ρ by tensoring the pullback-stalk comparison of P with the identity, then composing with the inverse target comparison. These are genuine chain isomorphisms.

The remaining equality for these fixed coordinates is precisely pinned_tensor_pullback_stalk_compatibility. Supply the two constructed isomorphisms as the existential witnesses and this equality as their property.
